verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own docs list a no-code Workflow Builder and call-handling 'State-based Rules' and 'Interaction Rules', which are first-party rules that route calls automatically. The evidence is only navigation-level mentions, so the depth of event-triggered automation is unproven. Event notifications and subscriptions are developer building blocks and earn no extra credit. Missing for 10: documentation of Workflow Builder triggers and actions, rule coverage beyond call routing (e.g. SMS or messaging events), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
